subject: icecream
name: 冰淇淋
label: 单球甜筒
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One round scoop of ice cream on a simple triangular cone, only two cone lines. STRICT SUBJECT: the ice cream itself is the entire artwork. No child, no person, no hand, no human body, no background scene. One scoop and one triangular cone only, large and centered with 12 percent blank margin.
